description: Gemma3 preprocessing passes configured height/width in the opposite order to PIL size and resize.
trigger: A rectangular configured preprocessing size with distinct height and width.
expected_behavior: PIL image.size and resize use (width, height), consistently with the configured dimensions and returned size metadata.
actual_behavior: preprocess constructs (height, width), compares that tuple with image.size and passes it to resize; a rectangular configured size is transposed. preprocessed_size is (height, width) beside original_size in (width, height). The autosplit shape uses height and width correctly. Square reference sizes hide the discrepancy.

verification.description: Reviewer compared configured tuple construction, PIL size/resize convention, metadata and default_load_shape_dtype.
verification.limits: Latent; no reach at the square 896 by 896 reference size. No image processing, loading or inference executed; no affected real checkpoint demonstrated.

affected_revisions.limits: Introducing revision only; no continuous affected range claimed, and square reference geometry does not trigger the issue.

cutoff_note: Post-hoc reviewer observation; administrative only, never teacher input.
